question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a yellow ball, Bob has a black ball, Claire has a pink ball, Dave has a white ball, Eve has a grey ball, Fred has a silver ball, and Gertrude has a blue ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Claire and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Dave and Bob swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Claire swap balls. Then, Claire and Fred swap balls. Then, Claire and Alice swap balls. Then, Dave and Eve swap balls. Finally, Fred and Bob swap balls. At the end of the game, Claire has the
Options:
(A) yellow ball
(B) black ball
(C) pink ball
(D) white ball
(E) grey ball
(F) silver ball
(G) blue ball
solution:
Read each row as the ball colors held by Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude, in that order.
Initial: yellow, black, pink, white, grey, silver, blue
1. Claire ↔ Gertrude: yellow, black, blue, white, grey, silver, pink
2. Dave ↔ Bob: yellow, white, blue, black, grey, silver, pink
3. Gertrude ↔ Claire: yellow, white, pink, black, grey, silver, blue
4. Claire ↔ Fred: yellow, white, silver, black, grey, pink, blue
5. Claire ↔ Alice: silver, white, yellow, black, grey, pink, blue
6. Dave ↔ Eve: silver, white, yellow, grey, black, pink, blue
7. Fred ↔ Bob: silver, pink, yellow, grey, black, white, blue
Claire holds the yellow ball (third entry), option (A).
Final answer: (A)
